MECA.TITLE: Cases in Which the SRS Side Airbag & SRS Curtain Shield Airbag Do Not Operate

ITEM.PTXT: Even in a side collision, depending on the collision conditions, the collision energy may be reduced by deformation of the vehicle body and doors so that the ignition criteria of the sensors are not reached, and the SRS side airbags & SRS curtain shield airbags may not operate.
